posts.title: Code is cheap. Personal software is next.
posts.description: Coding agents made code cheap. The biggest winners are personal apps and open source projects, where one person can now cover the whole stack end to end. A field report from four small agent-built apps.

posts.title: The price of power: why batteries are starting to look obvious
posts.description: German wholesale power averages €87/MWh — but at noon it's €36 and by 6 pm it's €143. A look at where the price actually comes from, hour by hour.

posts.title: Durable Functions for Indexing in RAG: A Practical Python Approach
posts.description: Azure Durable Functions streamline RAG indexing by combining push flexibility with pull reliability for scalable, efficient document processing.
